evidence.title: KDP Paperback Printing Cost
evidence.fact: KDP prints on demand and subtracts printing costs from royalties; no upfront printing cost or inventory required.

evidence.title: KDP Payment Options
evidence.fact: Payout methods depend on bank location; PayPal is not an offered KDP payout method. The published Africa table names South Africa, Egypt, Morocco, Tunisia, Kenya and Nigeria but does not list Senegal; Senegal payout method therefore remains unconfirmed.

evidence.title: Lulu Print-On-Demand
evidence.fact: Lulu prints when an order is placed; readers can order individual copies.

evidence.title: Lulu Creator Revenue Guide
evidence.fact: Lulu pays by PayPal or USD paper check, no bank transfer; PayPal payments support USD/CAD/AUD/EUR/GBP with $5 accumulated revenue threshold. Lulu's revenue model deducts production and applicable share from sales.

evidence.title: PayPal supported features
evidence.fact: PayPal lists Senegal as able to send, receive and withdraw. This supports the PayPal payout route, subject to account verification and Lulu's own acceptance.

evidence.title: IngramSpark compensation payments
evidence.fact: Print compensation is list price less wholesale discount, print cost and 1.875% global distribution fee; PayPal payout minimum $30, or bank deposits only for US, Canada, UK, Eurozone and Australia bank accounts; payout 90 days after month-end. Senegal eligibility/payment route still unconfirmed.

evidence.title: IngramSpark changes in print cost and fees
evidence.fact: Official 2026 pricing/fee change notice exists; exact applicable setup and market access fees must be checked before account/title activation.

evidence.title: Bookvault connected store payments
evidence.fact: Customer pays the publisher's own store; Bookvault separately charges the publisher for printing and shipping. This requires publisher funds before fulfilment.

evidence.title: Bookvault invoice credit account
evidence.fact: Registered businesses may apply for credit after a credit check; 30-day terms and a credit limit apply, currently only UK-facility orders. This is not a guaranteed zero-cost route and requires approved credit.

evidence.title: Blurb Instant Store
evidence.fact: Blurb says books print on demand, nothing is paid upfront by the author; print cost is deducted from each sale.

evidence.title: Blurb payout schedule
evidence.fact: Blurb pays monthly after thresholds; PayPal supported in USD/CAD/GBP/EUR/AUD, USD check option. Fees and thresholds apply.

evidence.title: PayPal supported features
evidence.fact: PayPal lists Senegal as able to send, receive and withdraw; Blurb account eligibility and tax/payout setup for Senegal still need confirmation.

evidence.title: Jumia Commissions 2026
evidence.fact: Official 2026 fee table lists 20% commission for Books, regardless of whether seller or Jumia stores stock; other logistics fees may apply.
